sections.title: 1. Introduction & Module Overview
sections.intro:
The Banquet module manages the complete lifecycle of weddings, conferences, parties and corporate events — from enquiry to final billing.

In Analysis HMS the banquet flow: Enquiry received → Venue availability check → Follow-up → Booking confirmed (with advance) → Function sheet (to kitchen/service) → Event execution → Proforma/Invoice → Final Billing + Outstanding follow-up.

BANQUET EVENT LIFECYCLE:
Inquiry → Follow-up → Booking (BEO - Banquet Event Order) → Function Sheet → Event Day → Billing → Payment Follow-up

subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Banquet ▶ Venue Master / Venue Features
subsections.paragraph: Define banquet halls/spaces — capacity (float/theatre/round table), features (projector, stage, green room), per-venue charges. Venue Availability and Booking run from this master.

subsections.caption: Events Master — banquet event types
subsections.paragraph: Event types (Wedding, Birthday, Conference, Kitty) and banquet menu packages (Veg/Non-veg per-plate rates). Event type + menu package are selected in the booking.

subsections.title: 3.1 Venue Availability
subsections.paragraph: Enter date range — which venue is free/booked on which date. Please check here before the client asks for the date. Tentative bookings will also be shown.

rows: Per date per venue — Free / Tentative / Confirmed

subsections.title: 3.2 Booking Inquiry & Follow-up
subsections.navPath: Banquet ▶ Operation ▶ Booking Inquiry / Inquiry follow up
subsections.paragraph: Record every inquiry — client, event type, date, expected guests, budget. In the follow-up screen, a note for every call + next follow-up date. The sales team converts leads from this.

rows: Which event, when, which venue interest?
Last note + next follow-up date (reminder list)

subsections.title: 3.3 Banquet Booking (BEO) — Core Screen
subsections.paragraph: The master document of a confirmed booking — Banquet Event Order. Venue, date, timing, menu package, per-plate rate, hall charges, advance terms, cancellation policy — all in one place. The BEO print goes to the kitchen/service teams.

rows: Event type, venue, date, timing (setup to end)
Menu package, guaranteed pax, rate per plate
Venue charges, F&B, extra services (deco, DJ)

subsections.title: 3.4 Venue Status & Daily Function Sheet
subsections.navPath: Banquet ▶ Operation ▶ Venue Status | Reports ▶ Daily Function Sheet
subsections.paragraph: Venue Status: live position for today/this week. Daily Function Sheet: full detail of today's events — venue, timings, menu, pax, contact person. This sheet reaches kitchen, service and housekeeping every morning.

rows: Who will handle it on site

subsections.title: 3.5 Proforma Invoice & Advance List
subsections.navPath: Banquet ▶ Operation ▶ Performa Invoice / Advance List
subsections.paragraph: Proforma Invoice: Estimate/advance request to the client before the event. Advance List: How much advance was received on which booking — pending advances follow-up.
steps: When advance is received, record it — it will be tracked in the Advance List

subsections.title: 3.6 Banquet Billing (Final Bill)
subsections.paragraph: Final bill after the event — actual pax, extra items, venue charges, GST, minus advances. For company events the bill goes to the city ledger (credit); retail is settled by cash/UPI.
steps: Print bill / post to city ledger

subsections.title: 4.2 Tax Reports
subsections.caption: Outstanding Report (with bill details)
subsections.paragraph: Banquet GST report — slab-wise breakup of venue rent (18%) and catering (5% without accommodation rule). The accountant uses it for GSTR filing.
